title: Token Exposure in AttachmentTab.jsp in Apache JSPWIKI in the effected version on all platforms exposes the Cross Site…
description: A vulnerability in Apache JSPWIKI's AttachmentTab.jsp exposes the Cross Site Request Forgery (CSRF) protected token via the address bar, potentially allowing attackers to obtain this token. The issue affects the version prior to 3.0.1 on all platforms. Upgrading to version 3.0.1 resolves the vulnerability.
